name: MPI Corporation
summary: MPI Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, repairs, imports/exports, and trades in semiconductor manufacturing and testing equipment in Taiwan, China, the United States, Singapore, Korea, and internationally. It offers probe cards comprising cantilever, kestrel, FCB, EVS, and osprey probe cards. The company also provides probe systems, RF and high-power characterization platforms, photonics automation, high bandwidth memory test, and thermal technologies.
